verdict.rationale: Requesty documents an in-product analytics dashboard for costs, requests, tokens and latency, plus MCP usage analytics. Nothing in the pack shows exporting gateway logs or traces to an external observability stack (no OpenTelemetry, log drains or export APIs). A built-in dashboard is an adjacent feature, not export, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can export gateway logs and traces to my own observability stack
